title: rec.list
description: v0.4.1 (docs/13 §8.1, §12.2): the recordings app asks cpad for one page of sessions, newest first by wall time. Sent only when the latest host hello carried caps.recs:true. cursor is the next of the previous page, sent back unchanged; absent = first page. Reply: rec.items, or error (E_BAD_FIELD, E_INTERNAL; E_UNKNOWN_TYPE from an older cpad).
